units: <cite ref="Ruth Rabbah 4:6">Ruth R. to II, 5</cite> <he>כיון שראה אותה נ׳ ומעשיה נאים</he> when he saw that she was lovely and her conduct becoming.—Pl. <he>נְעִימִים</he>; <he>נְעִימוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Ruth Rabbah 4:6">Ib.</cite> <he>מעשיה נאים ונ׳</he> her conduct is becoming and lovely.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 5:1">Midr. Till. to Ps. V</cite> <he>כל מה שנתתה לנו טובים ונ׳ הם</he> all the things which thou hast given us are good and pleasing.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 23:3">Gen. R. s. 23</cite>, v. <cite ref="N00992"><he>נַעֲמָה</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:4:1">Cant. R. to IV, 4</cite> <he>כולכם נ׳ וחסידים וכ׳</he> all of you are welcome, all of you are pious &c.; a. e.
